summary: A revised BBN schedule for adding core memory to IMPs and TIPs. Completed retrofits were removed and the CCA retrofit date moved from March 20 to February 28. It restates the text of RFC 434 and was itself replaced by RFC 476.

plainLanguage.summary: This RFC updates the schedule for adding memory to network IMPs and TIPs. It removes completed work and moves the CCA retrofit to a new date.

subtitle: The revised schedule for adding memory to network IMPs and TIPs.

tldr.problem: The network's IMP and TIP machines were scheduled to receive additional core memory, requiring coordinated work at each site.
tldr.mechanism: This revision removes retrofits completed before February and moves the CCA date to February 28, then lists the remaining site dates.
tldr.outcome: The schedule states the planned memory sizes and retrofit dates. RFC 476 later replaced this revision.

today: RFC 447 was replaced by RFC 476. It records a revised schedule for a one-time equipment retrofit.

sections.title: What Changed in the Revision
sections.content: RFC 447 revises RFC 434, which scheduled additional core memory for IMPs and TIPs during the first several months of 1973. This revision says that work scheduled before February 1 had been completed and was removed from the schedule. It also moves the CCA retrofit from March 20 to February 28.
sections.plainLanguage: This revision updates an earlier hardware-work schedule. It removes work already completed and gives CCA an earlier retrofit date.

sections.title: Planned Memory and Equipment Changes
sections.content: At the end of the retrofit program, the listed memory sizes were 16K words for an IMP (516 or 316), 28K words for a TIP, and 32K words for a TIP with the magnetic tape option. The expanded TIP memory required the TIP to occupy two cabinets.
sections.plainLanguage: The plan gives different final memory sizes for IMPs and TIPs. An expanded TIP would also need two cabinets.

sections.title: Remaining Site Dates
sections.content: The remaining retrofit dates run from Utah on February 1 through Illinois on April 18. The schedule was arranged to coincide with regular monthly preventive maintenance, but the RFC warns that the work could keep machines down longer than usual. Sites expecting difficulty with the extra TIP floor-space requirement were asked to contact BBN.
sections.plainLanguage: The RFC lists a planned date for each site. Work was coordinated with maintenance, although a machine could be unavailable longer than usual.

sections.title: Status of the Schedule
sections.content: This RFC is a revision to a dated retrofit schedule. The unit metadata identifies RFC 476 as its replacement.
sections.plainLanguage: This schedule describes planned work in 1973. RFC 476 later replaced it.
